issue_context.title: Taxon promotion rule form problem
issue_context.body:
## Context I can submit promotion rule of `Taxon`, but after saved, it does not display that saved item. See `Steps to Reproduce`. This might be problem of `backend/app/views/spree/admin/promotions/rules/_taxon.html.erb`, I think. ## Expected Behavior It displays that saved item(s). ## Actual Behavior After creating the rule, It does not display that saved item(s). ## Possible Fix ```diff --- a/backend/app/views/spree/admin/promotions/rules/_taxon.html.erb +++ b/backend/app/views/spree/admin/promotions/rules/_taxon.html.erb @@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
- <%= label_tag "#{param_prefix}_taxon_ids_string", Spree.t('taxon_rule.choose_taxons') %> - <%= select_tag "#{param_prefix}[taxon_ids_string]", nil, class: 'taxon_picker d-block w-100', id: :product_taxon_ids %> + <%= label_tag "#{param_prefix}_taxon_ids", Spree.t('taxon_rule.choose_taxons') %> + <%= select_tag "#{param_prefix}[taxon_ids]", options_from_collection_for_select(promotion_rule.taxons, :id, :pretty_name, promotion_rule.taxons.pluck(:id)), class: 'taxon_picker d-block w-100',multiple: true, id: :product_taxon_ids %>
<%= label_tag Spree.t('taxon_rule.label') %> ``` ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Set taxon(s) in promotion rule of taxon form 2. Click ✔️Update 3. Submitting form will succeed, but you cannot find saved taxon item. ## Your Environment * Version used: spree4.2.0
